criteria.criterion: crates/athena-core/src/status.rs has fewer than 1500 production lines (total lines minus #[cfg(test)] module ranges, counted as code_health::measure_source does), down from about 2439 at base. A reader can count it from the file, and the before and after figures appear in the producer's final report and the CHANGELOG entry.
criteria.evidence: I read the candidate status.rs. It is 3298 lines. Its #[cfg(test)] modules run from the attribute to the closing brace: mistake_tests 1206 to about 1422, build_measurement_tests 1424 to about 1557, and the third test module 1559 to 1286+2000=3286. That is 3298 minus 2079 = about 1219 production lines, the same as the CHANGELOG's '1219 after'. The 'about 2452 before' figure is the 2439 lines before the tests plus the non-test `mod erased` at the end of the file, which measure_source also counts. CHANGELOG.md states both figures. The producer's final report is not in this snapshot, so I could not check it.

The open-job next lines moved into `open_job_next_lines` and the proposal next lines into `proposal_next_lines`. summary: The change passes: all seven criteria are met. It moves the planning, keep-rule, later-harm and producer-settings code into crates/athena-core/src/status/planning.rs (449 lines), and the throughput, waste and check-duration code into status/throughput.rs (846 lines). Both are re-exported with `pub use`. The only visibility change is the private `first_round_accepted`, which becomes pub(super), so the public API does not grow. I counted the file myself: status.rs drops to about 1219 production lines (total minus the #[cfg(test)] module ranges), against about 2452 at base, matching the CHANGELOG. `Athena::status` is now 130 lines; the job loop is in `scan_jobs`, and the open-job and proposal next lines are in their own helpers. `git log -L` shows that StatusView and the whole test region are unchanged since base. No lint suppression is added, the next-line texts and their order are unchanged, and every new module and helper has a doc comment. The recorded fmt, clippy and test checks passed. My targeted `cargo test -p athena-core --lib status::` passed 39 tests, and the snapshot status command printed the throughput section correctly. One minor finding: the CHANGELOG says status delegates 'the next-step lines', but only the open-job and proposal lines moved out; the rest are still built inline. The producer's final report is not in this snapshot, so I could not check that it gives the before and after line counts.
